message:

hold_reason: Refund for order 145 (9501 cents) was requested for this batch but is missing from the refunds table, which lists only orders 140 and 144. Net balances computed now would overpay the affected customer. No payouts recorded. Needs review of the order 145 refund before the batch proceeds.

reply.thought: The handoff lists three refunds requested for this batch, but W2 reports only two as applied (order 145 is missing). Before any payout, I need to check the refunds table directly.
